Top IT companies in India are well-known for their contributions to the technology sector. However, please note that rankings and statuses can change over time. Here are some of the prominent IT companies in India:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS): TCS is one of the largest and most well-known IT services companies in India. It provides a wide range of IT services, including consulting, software development, and outsourcing.
Infosys: Infosys is another major player in the Indian IT industry. It offers services such as IT consulting, software development, and business process outsourcing.
